description: This file contains database migration logic for the focalboard project, including migration execution, SQL statement generation, and database schema management.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: Struct representing the SQL storage layer for focalboard, handling database migrations and schema management.

methods.name: getMigrationConnection
methods.description: Establishes and returns a database connection configured for migrations, with special handling for MySQL multi-statements.

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Performs database schema migrations, applying necessary updates and running migration scripts.

methods.name: runMigrationSequence
methods.description: Executes all migration steps in order, including data migrations and schema updates.

methods.name: ensureMigrationsAppliedUpToVersion
methods.description: Ensures that migrations up to a specified version are applied to the database.

methods.name: GetTemplateHelperFuncs
methods.description: Provides helper functions for SQL template generation.

methods.name: genAddColumnIfNeeded
methods.description: Generates SQL to add a column if it does not already exist, tailored for different database types.

methods.name: genDropColumnIfNeeded
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop a column if it exists, tailored for different database types.

methods.name: genCreateIndexIfNeeded
methods.description: Generates SQL to create an index if it does not already exist.

methods.name: genRenameTableIfNeeded
methods.description: Generates SQL to rename a table if it does not already have the new name.

methods.name: genRenameColumnIfNeeded
methods.description: Generates SQL to rename a column if it does not already have the new name.

methods.name: doesTableExist
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the database.

methods.name: doesColumnExist
methods.description: Checks if a column exists in a specified table.

methods.name: genAddConstraintIfNeeded
methods.description: Generates SQL to add a constraint if it does not already exist.

methods.name: normalizeTablename
methods.description: Normalizes a table name by adding schema prefix if needed.

methods.name: getIndexName
methods.description: Constructs an index name based on table and columns.

methods.name: replaceVars
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in SQL templates with actual values.
